name: UCI-HAR → HHAR
description: Train on UCI-HAR (6 activities, waist smartphone, 50Hz, 30 subjects) and evaluate on HHAR (6 activities, multiple phone models, 50Hz resampled, 9 subjects). 5 shared classes are evaluated: Walking, Walking Upstairs/Stairs Up, Walking Downstairs/Stairs Down, Sitting, Standing. UCI-HAR Laying and HHAR Biking are excluded. This pair tests generalization from a single homogeneous device to heterogeneous devices.

protocol.type: Train on source, test on target
protocol.note: HHAR data resampled to 50Hz. Report mean ± std across 9 LOSO folds.
